id.app.title: Design System
id.app.subtitle: Panel kendali design system E-Systems
id.status.healthy: Sehat — tidak ada yang perlu ditangani
id.home.stack.title: Design system
id.home.stack.note: Ikon di panel ini pakai Lucide — itu hanya kulit tool. Produk kamu pakai Tabler, sesuai spec di atas.
id.home.notInstalled.body: Design system belum terpasang di repo ini. Pemasangan Level 0 tidak mengubah build sama sekali dan bisa dibatalkan dalam satu commit.
id.attn.legacy.title: Ada sisa design system versi lama
id.attn.legacy.body: File dari paket v1/v2 masih tertinggal. Ini bukan kode asli portal kamu.
id.attn.drift.title: diubah manual
id.attn.drift.contract: File kontrak — seharusnya sama dengan template.
id.attn.drift.living: Peta bindings berkembang. Ini wajar (CLAUDE.md §4) — kirim ke desainer supaya bisa masuk rilis berikutnya.
id.attn.halfwired.title: Level 1 setengah terpasang
id.attn.halfwired.body: Pasang keduanya atau tidak sama sekali.
id.attn.update.title: Update tersedia
id.attn.dirty.title: Ada perubahan belum di-commit
id.attn.dirty.body: Commit dulu supaya commit adopsi tetap bersih.
id.attn.selfupdate.title: Panel ini sudah usang
id.attn.selfupdate.body: Versi lebih baru tersedia di dalam design system.
id.attn.unmanaged.title: Terpasang tanpa catatan
id.attn.unmanaged.body: Repo ini dipasang oleh panel versi lama, jadi belum punya struk pemasangan. Deteksi perubahan, revert presisi, dan rollback butuh struk itu.
id.setup.title: Pasang design system
id.setup.lead: Bukan installer — ini versi terpandu dari tutorial resmi. Rencana lengkap selalu tampil sebelum apa pun dijalankan.
id.setup.repoUrl.hint: Bisa diganti ke repo mana pun yang berisi design system ini.
id.setup.level0.desc: Tanpa risiko. Grounding AI aktif, build tidak disentuh.
id.setup.level1.desc: Menambah 2 baris ke config. Token live + dark mode. Perlu kode akses.
id.setup.l1code.hint: Level 1 menyentuh 2 baris config build, jadi perlu persetujuan pemelihara design system.
id.setup.commit.hint: Biarkan kosong kalau mau coba dulu.
id.setup.installed: Design system sudah terpasang di repo ini. Menjalankan ulang aman — langkah yang sudah beres akan dilewati.
id.setup.done: Selesai. Buka editor dan lanjut kerja seperti biasa — AI sekarang membaca aturan design system otomatis.
id.legacy.title: Terdeteksi file design system versi lama
id.legacy.body: File di bawah ini sisa paket design system lama (v1/v2) yang pernah dipasang di repo ini. Ini bukan komponen atau kode asli portal kamu — kode asli tidak akan disentuh. Membiarkannya sering memicu konflik saat pasang versi baru.
id.health.doctor.hint: Read-only. Tidak pernah menulis file apa pun.
id.health.drift.none: Semua file yang dikelola sesuai dengan template.
id.health.receipt.hint: Persis semua yang pernah disentuh panel ini, beserta hash-nya.
id.health.repo.hint: Untuk saat repo design system pindah host.
id.health.uninstall.hint: Menghapus semua yang ditambahkan panel ini. Kode, komponen, dan riwayat git kamu tidak tersentuh.
id.ver.rollback.hint: Kembali ke versi design system sebelumnya.
id.ver.impact.none: Tidak ada token atau spec yang dihapus. Aman.
id.prompts.title: Pustaka prompt AI
id.prompts.lead: Prompt siap pakai untuk AI coding agent kamu. Setiap prompt sudah membawa aturan design system repo ini dan menyesuaikan level adopsi.
id.prompts.stack: Prompt menyasar stack produk kamu: Fustat · Tabler · text style .ts-*
id.prompts.tip: Hasil paling presisi dengan Claude Opus terbaru, reasoning effort high.
id.prompts.locked: Pasang design system dulu — setelah itu pustaka prompt lengkap muncul di sini.
id.docs.title: Dokumen & galeri
id.docs.lead: Galeri komponen dan seluruh dokumen, dibuka langsung dari versi yang sedang terpasang.
id.plan.title: Persis inilah yang akan terjadi
id.plan.lead: Tinjau setiap langkah. Belum ada yang dijalankan.
id.diff.title: Perbandingan
id.diff.restoreNote: Mengembalikan akan mengganti isinya dengan template dari panel versi
id.diff.backupNote: Versi kamu disalin dulu ke .ds/.trash/ sebelum diganti.
id.cr.title: Kirim ke desainer
id.cr.lead: Perubahan kamu dikemas jadi permintaan perubahan, lalu email terbuka otomatis.
id.cr.reason.ph: Contoh: komponen Kendo butuh kelas tambahan yang belum ada di template.
id.cr.clipboard: Isi lengkap sudah disalin ke clipboard.
id.log.stopped: Berhenti — perbaiki langkah yang gagal lalu klik lagi. Aman diulang.
id.lock.note: Proses ini sudah dijalankan di sesi ini. Untuk menjalankan lagi, tutup panel lalu buka lagi.
id.foot.by: Design system oleh Raihan A. — UI/UX, ITS Elabram

en.app.title: Design System
en.app.subtitle: Control panel for the E-Systems design system
en.home.stack.title: Design system
en.home.stack.note: This panel's own UI uses Lucide icons — tool chrome only. Your product uses Tabler, per the spec above.
en.home.notInstalled.body: The design system is not installed in this repo yet. A Level 0 install changes nothing in your build and reverts in one commit.
en.attn.legacy.title: Leftovers from an older design system
en.attn.legacy.body: Files from the v1/v2 package are still here. These are not your portal's own code.
en.attn.drift.title: was edited by hand
en.attn.drift.contract: Contract file — should match the template.
en.attn.drift.living: The bindings map has evolved. That is expected (CLAUDE.md §4) — send it to the designer so it can land in the next release.
en.attn.halfwired.title: Level 1 is half-wired
en.attn.update.title: Update available
en.attn.dirty.title: Uncommitted changes
en.attn.dirty.body: Commit them first so the adoption commit stays clean.
en.attn.selfupdate.title: This panel is out of date
en.attn.selfupdate.body: A newer version ships inside the design system.
en.attn.unmanaged.title: Installed without a receipt
en.attn.unmanaged.body: This repo was installed by an older panel, so there is no install receipt. Drift detection, exact revert and rollback all depend on it.
en.setup.title: Install the design system
en.setup.lead: Not an installer — a guided version of the official tutorial. You always see the full plan before anything runs.
en.setup.repoUrl.hint: Point this at any repo that holds this design system.
en.setup.level0.desc: Zero risk. AI grounding on, build untouched.
en.setup.level1.desc: Adds 2 lines to your config. Live tokens + dark mode. Needs an access code.
en.setup.l1code.hint: Level 1 touches 2 lines of build config, so it needs a go-ahead from whoever maintains the design system.
en.setup.commit.hint: Leave unchecked to try it out first.
en.setup.installed: The design system is already installed here. Re-running is harmless — satisfied steps are skipped.
en.setup.done: All set. Open your editor and work as usual — the AI now reads your design system rules automatically.
en.legacy.title: Older design system files detected
en.legacy.body: The files below are leftovers from an older design system package (v1/v2) that was once installed here. They are not your portal's own components or code — nothing of yours will be touched. Leaving them tends to cause conflicts when installing the new version.
en.health.doctor.hint: Read-only. It never writes a single file.
en.health.drift.none: Every managed file matches its template.
en.health.receipt.hint: Exactly everything this panel has ever touched, with hashes.
en.health.repo.hint: For when the design system repo moves host.
en.health.uninstall.hint: Removes everything this panel added. Your code, components and git history are untouched.
en.ver.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
en.ver.rollback.hint: Return to the previous design system version.
en.ver.impact.none: No tokens or specs are removed. Safe.
en.prompts.title: AI prompt library
en.prompts.lead: Ready-made prompts for your AI coding agent. Each one already carries this repo's design system rules and adapts to your adoption level.
en.prompts.stack: Prompts target your product stack: Fustat · Tabler · .ts-* text styles
en.prompts.tip: Most precise on the latest Claude Opus with reasoning effort set to high.
en.prompts.locked: Install the design system first — the full prompt library appears here afterwards.
en.docs.title: Docs & gallery
en.docs.lead: The component gallery and every document, opened straight from the installed version.
en.plan.title: This is exactly what will happen
en.plan.lead: Review every step. Nothing has run yet.
en.diff.title: Comparison
en.diff.restoreNote: Restoring will replace this with the template from panel version
en.diff.backupNote: Your version is copied to .ds/.trash/ before anything is replaced.
en.cr.title: Send to designer
en.cr.lead: Your change is packaged as a change request, then your mail client opens.
en.cr.reason.ph: Example: the Kendo component needs an extra class the template does not cover yet.
en.cr.clipboard: The full text is on your clipboard.
en.log.stopped: Stopped — fix the failing step and click again. Safe to re-run.
en.lock.note: This operation already ran in this session. To run it again, close the panel and start it once more.
en.foot.by: Design system by Raihan A. — UI/UX, ITS Elabram
